xna-type.name: Microphone
xna-type.summary: Provides properties, methods, and fields and events for capturing audio data with microphones.

property.name: All
property.summary: Returns the collection of all currently-available microphones.
property.remarks: Windows Phone Specific Information This property will always return the default microphone on Windows Phone, and it will only return one device.

property.name: BufferDuration
property.summary: Gets or sets audio capture buffer duration of the microphone.
property.remarks: The duration of the capture buffer must be between 100ms and 1000ms. Additionally, the capture buffer must be 10ms aligned (BufferDuration % 10 == 0). Silverlight applications must ensure that FrameworkDispatcher.Update is called regularly in order for "fire and forget" sounds to work correctly. BufferDuration throws an InvalidOperationException if FrameworkDispatcher.Update has not been called at least once before making this call. For more information, see Enable XNA Framework Events in Windows Phone Applications .

property.name: IsHeadset
property.summary: Determines if the microphone is a wired headset or a Bluetooth device.
property.remarks: Always returns true for Windows Phone devices.

property.name: SampleRate
property.summary: Returns the sample rate at which the microphone is capturing audio data.

property.name: State
property.summary: Returns the recording state of the Microphone object.

method.name: GetData
method.summary: Gets the latest recorded data from the microphone based on the audio capture buffer.

overload.summary: Gets the latest recorded data from the microphone based on the audio capture buffer.

parameters.parameter: Buffer, in bytes, containing the captured audio data. The audio format must be PCM wave data.

overload.returns: The buffer size, in bytes, of the audio data.
overload.remarks: Silverlight applications must ensure that FrameworkDispatcher.Update is called regularly in order for "fire and forget" sounds to work correctly. GetData throws an InvalidOperationException if FrameworkDispatcher.Update has not been called at least once before making this call. For more information, see Enable XNA Framework Events in Windows Phone Applications . For information about an audio format using XNA Game Studio, see Audio API Developers Guide .

overload.summary: Gets the latest captured audio data from the microphone based on the specified offset and byte count.

parameters.parameter: Buffer, in bytes, containing the captured audio data. The audio format must be PCM wave data.
Offset, in bytes, to the starting position of the data.
Amount, in bytes, of desired audio data.

overload.returns: The buffer size, in bytes, of the audio data.
overload.remarks: For information about an audio format using XNA Game Studio, see Audio API Developers Guide .

method.name: GetSampleDuration
method.summary: Returns the duration of audio playback based on the size of the buffer.

overload.summary: Returns the duration of audio playback based on the size of the buffer.

parameters.parameter: Size, in bytes, of the audio data.

overload.returns: TimeSpan object that represents the duration of the audio playback.
overload.remarks: sizeInBytes must satisfy format alignment restrictions.

method.name: GetSampleSizeInBytes
method.summary: Returns the size of the byte array required to hold the specified duration of audio for this microphone object.

overload.summary: Returns the size of the byte array required to hold the specified duration of audio for this microphone object.

parameters.parameter: TimeSpan object that contains the duration of the audio sample.

overload.returns: Size (10 ms block aligned), in bytes, of the audio buffer.

overload.remarks: Silverlight applications must ensure that FrameworkDispatcher.Update is called regularly in order for "fire and forget" sounds to work correctly. Start throws an InvalidOperationException if FrameworkDispatcher.Update has not been called at least once before making this call. For more information, see Enable XNA Framework Events in Windows Phone Applications .

field.name: Name
field.summary: Returns the friendly name of the microphone.

event.name: BufferReady
event.summary: Event that occurs when the audio capture buffer is ready to processed.
